name: Fable Pay: Finance App Launch - ( w/ ElevenLabs voicover as placeholder)
description:
A 9:16 finance app launch built to swap in your own product. Tilted 3D iPhone frames, liquid-glass feature chips, a count-up proof shot and a download button, with tactile sound design and ambient bed already timed. Replace the screens, the brand name and the copy, and it’s ready to post.

Audio Disclaimer: The preview uses placeholder voiceover generated with the ElevenLabs Free Plan. It is for demonstration purposes only and is not licensed for commercial use. Before commercial use, replace it with your own appropriately licensed voiceover.
